title: debian: Make Lintian happy about version numbers
description:

doesn't like it because it looks like a Debian version number

commits_data.message:
debian: Make Lintian happy about version numbers

Don't include a hyphen and anything after it, lintian
doesn't like it because it looks like a Debian version number
